writeup: Woot has an open-box GoSports 10-by-8 Range Cage with the printed impact screen (model GOLF-NET-CAGE-10x8-RANGE) for $49.99. Dick's Sporting Goods and GoSports both still sell this exact cage — the printed-screen 10X8IMPACTSCRN / GOLF-NET-CAGE-10x8-RANGE with top and side nets — in stock at $299.99. That is about 83 percent below those stores and saves roughly $250. Woot showed only 1 left, with a limit of three per customer.
